title: Pivotality under sign negation
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, and let $i$ be a coordinate and $x$ an input. The function $-f$, obtained by negating every output of $f$, is pivotal at $x$ in coordinate $i$ if and only if $f$ is pivotal there.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function f on the n-dimensional sign cube
